response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals and 20 years of technical experience meeting the minimum requirement, this Principal Performance Architect role is fundamentally focused on hardware architecture, chip/SoC design, and AI accelerator optimization. The candidate's entire career has been in software development with no experience in SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, or deep-learning workload optimization—all core requirements. The gap between software engineering and specialized hardware architecture design is substantial.
strengths: 20 years of technical experience meeting the educational/experience pathway requirements (Bachelor's + 8+ years)
Proven performance optimization skills from Optilyz and Dunnhumby roles, including real-time systems and low-latency application design
Strong systems architecture and design background with demonstrated ability to learn diverse technical domains and master new technologies
concerns: No experience with SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, or hardware accelerator design—all critical core requirements for the role
Career entirely focused on software development with zero deep-learning workload optimization or AI hardware expertise
Lacks the specialized computer architecture, chip design, and SIMD/MIMD experience essential for Principal-level hardware performance engineering

key_factors.factor: General software engineering competence and experience
